t: What Carbon Removal Verification Database Is All About
title: What Carbon Removal Verification Database Is All About
description: Carbon removal must be real, additional, and durable: planting trees (decades, reversible), direct air capture (Climeworks: ~$600+/ton, millennia in basalt), enhanced weathering, and biochar (centuries). Verification is the product — without measurement, reporting, and verification (MRV), credits are fiction. Durability classes (100+ years vs millennia) decide what counts for what. This database is the complete carbon removal method: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
